description: Sector diffusion effect analysis — when sector leaders pull back and second-tier stocks catch up
context: User asking about sector rotation patterns where money flows from leaders to laggards.
user_input_examples: 龙头股开始跌了，二线股在涨，板块还能做吗？
板块内部分化严重怎么解读？

structure.current_status: Sector leader vs follower performance comparison
structure.suggestion: Position adjustment based on diffusion phase
structure.risks: Late-stage diffusion often precedes sector-wide correction

key_principles: Leaders lead on the way up AND on the way down — leader reversal is the first warning
Money rotating from leaders to laggards = late-cycle behavior, sector top may be near
Diffusion breadth (number of stocks participating) peaks before price peaks
When laggards catch up and leaders don't make new highs, it's a bearish divergence
Early diffusion (leaders still strong, laggards joining) is healthy; late diffusion (leaders falling) is dangerous

decision_tree.if_leaders_strong_and_laggards_joining: Healthy bull market, hold leaders, can add small laggard positions
decision_tree.if_leaders_stalling_and_laggards_catchin: Late cycle, reduce total sector exposure by 30-50%
decision_tree.if_leaders_falling_and_only_laggards_ris: Final stage, exit sector positions within 1-3 days
